highlights: The AI agent landscape is rapidly evolving with new frameworks and products focused on enterprise integration, self-improvement, and efficient planning, addressing key challenges in real-world deployment.

Major model releases include highly cost-effective options with large context windows, specialized open-source models for coding, and innovative multimodal decision models optimized for real-time edge applications.

The developer tool ecosystem is expanding with solutions for optimizing LLM inference costs, enhancing model deployment security, and providing robust environments for evaluating and training complex autonomous agents.

agents.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent for Enterprise Work
agents.summary: Google Cloud introduced a unified Gemini agent for enterprises, designed to handle diverse tasks from a single prompt and API, including answering questions, knowledge work, media creation, and code generation/execution.

agents.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Enterprise Data for Agents
agents.summary: SAP open-sourced STS, a schema-free data synthesis paradigm where an LLM agent generates valid enterprise data by interacting with simulated environments and policy-enforcing APIs, achieving high fidelity and constraint satisfaction for agent training without real data access.

agents.title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
agents.summary: Introduces Plan-and-Patch, a framework utilizing diffusion language models (dLLMs) for faster and more effective plan generation and repair in long-horizon agents, enabling partial plan revisions to maintain structure and improve task success rates.

models.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Haiku 5.5: 1M Context at $0.10/Million Input Tokens
models.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, a highly cost-effective model with a 1M token context window, enabling developers to integrate extensive context capabilities at a significantly reduced price point for diverse applications.

models.title: JetBrains Releases Mellum2.1: A 12B MoE Open Model for Coding Agents
models.summary: JetBrains launched Mellum2.1, an Apache 2.0 licensed 12B mixture-of-experts model optimized for coding agents, which significantly improved its SWE-bench Verified score through reinforcement learning, making it a powerful open-source option for code generation and repair.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models with Zero Output Tokens
models.summary: Liquid AI introduced open-weight multimodal d1-3B and d1-omni-600M models designed for real-time decision-making, capable of processing text, images, and audio to return calibrated, typed answers with zero output tokens for extreme efficiency.

tools.title: Architect Launches Liquid Inference: Real-Time Auction for LLM Inference
tools.summary: Architect Financial Technologies released Liquid Inference, an LLM router and marketplace that uses a real-time auction system for every prompt, allowing developers to optimize inference costs by dynamically selecting the lowest-bid provider that meets their criteria.

tools.title: Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Model Repos for Security Before Running
tools.summary: Unsloth Studio introduced a robust security framework that re-checks custom model code, weights, packages, and tools before execution, scanning for vulnerabilities and blocking flagged components to ensure secure and reliable AI model deployment.

tools.title: StoreBench: Live-Commerce Environment for Autonomous Operator Agents
tools.summary: StoreBench offers a production-grade live-commerce environment for evaluating and training autonomous operator agents, providing a realistic, long-horizon benchmark with merchant tools and calibrated pass thresholds for economic judgment under uncertainty.

companies.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent for Enterprise Work
companies.summary: Google Cloud unveiled its Gemini agent, a universal, cloud-hosted solution designed to streamline enterprise workflows by enabling a single agent to perform diverse tasks, including answering questions, knowledge management, content creation, and code execution, all from one prompt box and API.

companies.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI Globally
companies.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 globally within ChatGPT, enhanced with an Intelligent UI that delivers faster responses and integrates visual and interactive experiences, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible and engaging for all users.

companies.title: Atlassian and OpenAI Expand Partnership for Enterprise AI
companies.summary: Atlassian and OpenAI are deepening their partnership to leverage frontier models with enterprise knowledge, aiming to transform how teams plan, build, and deliver work by integrating advanced AI into core business processes.

learning.title: Google Research RRSI Guide: Mastering Self-Improving AI Agents
learning.summary: Google Research released a comprehensive coding guide for RRSI (Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement), providing developers with detailed insights into enabling safe, efficient, and self-improving AI agents through practical techniques like noise bands and cost rules.

learning.title: DevFest 2026 Focuses on Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 is returning with over 800 global events, offering developers opportunities to connect, build, secure, and scale solutions, particularly focusing on the agentic AI era through workshops and community engagement.

learning.title: OpenAI Helps Teens Learn and Plan with ChatGPT Features
learning.summary: OpenAI is integrating 'College Planner' into ChatGPT for Teens, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council, to empower students with AI tools for learning, planning, and engaging in the future development of AI.
